name: Tio
source:
An unpredictable and spoiled child, however he is a famous artist who's paintings sell for exorbitant amounts of money.
He's moved into a studio above the Kokono Kokono cafe. When he's excited he jumps up and down, when he's tired he sleeps on your lap, he's that kind of a cat-like person.

However, for some reason he has the problem of not being able to keep his memories for more than one day.
